BiblicalUsage: Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard burns the house of the LORD and the king's house and breaks down the walls of Jerusalem, and he carries away the captives that remain. He is named again when he comes to Jerusalem and again when the captives are counted.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Nebuzaradan is the face of judgment carried out: he burns what God has left and carries away whom God has given up, and the city falls because the LORD gave it into his hand.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
